teacher.headline: First full year in post, induction under way
teacher.why: A headteacher reads a teacher's CV for three things before any of the prose: what you can legally be employed to teach, which key stages you have actually stood in front of, and whether you are safe to leave with children. QTS, the teacher reference number and induction status therefore sit in plain sight. Every placement here names its year group, the school's intake and what came out of it, because "placement in a primary school" tells a timetabler nothing.

teacher.headline: Six years, biology, and an AP programme rebuilt
teacher.why: An American teaching CV is a licence document first: the state, the grade band and the subject endorsement decide what a principal can put on your timetable, so they go near the top with the number and the expiry date. The results are written to show access as well as attainment - the pass rate rose while the number of students sitting the exam nearly tripled, which is the harder achievement and the one a hiring committee will ask about.

professor.headline: First permanent post after a postdoc
professor.why: An academic CV is not a resume and is not meant to be short: a panel reads it for completeness and scores four things separately - outputs, funding, teaching recognition and supervision. professor.headline: One monograph out, a second under contract
professor.why: Humanities CVs are counted differently from science ones, and this is where candidates lose marks. The monograph is the unit of account, not the paper, so the book comes first with its press and its reviews. Research languages, palaeography and archive access are hiring criteria in their own right and belong in the skills block. And the funding here buys time rather than equipment, so every grant says what it bought: a year of teaching relief is an output, not a line of income.

professor.headline: Chair in materials chemistry, running a school
professor.why: By professorial level the CV is scored on money brought in, people trained and things run, and the publication list becomes a selection with the full one appended - 182 entries printed out in full stop being read. Two conventions carry the document: state your role and the share that reached your institution on every grant, and keep the leadership record apart from the research record, because a head-of-school appointment and a chair are decided by different panels asking different questions.
